snippet.title: Sempai No Namida 0.3.0 First Look!
snippet.description:
Hey guys! Yep, today (4/26) it's DSYCRAFT's birthday :) thank you to all for helping and playing SNN, here is the first look of the rewoked versions of World 1 and World 2. Sadly, the update isn't finish yet, but maybe the waiting may be not to long. Thank you for all guys!
